skills.name: Stampede
skills.description:
Launch across the earth and smash an enemy, dealing |cffffff2545|r Physical Damage to them and all nearby enemies. This attack is always a Critical Strike.

After reaching your target, you sunder the ground beneath you, dealing |cffffff551|r Physical Damage to all enemies in the area every |cffffff1|r second for |cffffff15|r seconds.

skills.name: Rune of Displacement
skills.description:
Devise a discharging rune under an enemy. After |cffffff2|r seconds the rune pulses, pulling in foes between 2 to 10 meters and etching them with scrawled glyphs that deal |cffffff7800|r Magic Damage over |cffffff18|r seconds.

An ally near the initial target can activate the Runebreak synergy, dealing |cffffff4927|r Frost Damage to enemies within 7 meters.

skills.name: Inspired Scholarship
skills.description:
Etch a series of runes onto your weapon that pulse with power once every |cffffff3|r seconds. Each pulse enhances your Arcanist skills, and striking an enemy with one deals an additional |cffffff1615|r Magic Damage and generates Crux if you have none.

While slotted on either ability bar, gain Major Brutality, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff20|r%.

skills.name: Spiked Bone Shield
skills.description:
Surround yourself with a whirlwind of bones, gaining a damage shield that absorbs up to |cffffff9828|r damage for |cffffff6|r seconds and returns |cffffff95|r% of direct damage absorbed back to the enemy. This ability scales off your Max Health.

An ally near you can activate the Bone Wall synergy, granting the ally and up to |cffffff5|r other allies a damage shield equal to |cffffff35|r% of their Max Health for |cffffff6|r seconds.

skills.name: Necrotic Orb
skills.description:
Project a globe of annihilation that slowly floats forward for |cffffff10|r seconds, dealing |cffffff534|r Magic Damage every |cffffff1|r second to nearby enemies. 

An ally near the globe can activate the Combustion synergy, causing the orb to explode for |cffffff4106|r Magic Damage to nearby enemies and restore |cffffff3960|r Magicka or Stamina to the ally, whichever maximum is higher.

skills.name: Soul Harvest
skills.description:
Ravage an enemy with a spinning attack, dealing |cffffff6423|r Magic Damage and increasing your damage against them by |cffffff20|r% for |cffffff8|r seconds.

Also afflicts the enemy with Major Defile, reducing their healing received and damage shield strength by |cffffff12|r%.

While slotted on either bar, any time you kill an enemy you gain |cffffff10|r Ultimate.
